description:
College student Dain has been suffering from a strange jinx that makes her touch other people’s chests. While searching for a solution, she meets Jihun, who is experiencing a similar phenomenon. However, unlike Dain, Jihun’s problem is not that he touches others, but that he keeps getting touched. And so, from their very first meeting, the two end up caught in an accident where one touches and the other is touched on the chest…!
